props.text: **[00:00:12] MODERATOR:** Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for joining us today.
**[00:00:25] REPORTER (Jane Cole, Daily Ledger):** Can you confirm whether the board has reached a decision on the proposed merger?
**[00:00:41] CEO (Maria Lopez):** Yes. After months of review, the board has voted to proceed with the merger, subject to regulatory approval.
**[00:01:03] REPORTER (Tom Reiss, Wire News):** What does this mean for employees and current contracts?
**[00:01:15] CEO (Maria Lopez):** All current employees will be retained for at least twelve months, and existing contracts will be honored in full.

props.title: Announced Decision
props.description: The board has voted to proceed with the merger, subject to regulatory approval.
